teaser: A small kernel and components loaded when needed: a browser for one app, one agent or a reader. Mozilla can build it, and should sell it as speed.
core_idea: The browser is the biggest attack surface we run and we now give it to agents; a minimal viable browser keeps a small kernel and loads components only when a page or agent needs them, boxes every extension, and gives each agent a browser with nothing to leak; Mozilla has the engine, brand and model to build it, and the pitch is speed.

nodes.label: Sell it as speed
nodes.summary: Starts at once, a fraction of the memory.

quotes.text: An agent's browser that has no accounts, no extensions, no file access and only the origins its task needs cannot leak a password it never had or a file it cannot open.
The pitch to Mozilla should not be security.
